title: Property evaluation of two anticancer candidate platinum complexes with N-isobutyl glycine ligand against human colon cancer.
authors: Hosseini Hashemi, Zahra; Mirzaei, Masoud; Eslami Moghadam, Mahboube
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铂配合物与DNA的相互作用，采用光谱实验、DFT计算和分子对接预测结合模式，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Small molecules have potential usage in cancer therapy due to their remarkable potency of disarranging the natural structure of nucleic acids. In this study, two complexes [Pt(NH(3))(2)(IBgly)]NO(3) (1) and [Pt(bipy)(IBgly)]NO(3) (2) based on Pt(II), N-isobutylglycine (IBgly), 2,2'-bipyridine, and ammonia were prepared and characterized by spectroscopic methods. Pharmacokinetic ADME data, absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and bioavailability radar showed two complexes can be introduced for Pt-based anti-cancer drugs. Mechanism of tumor inhibition and DNA interaction of these compounds was studied by UV-Vis, fluorescence, and CD spectroscopies. Also, thermodynamic parameters and the binding constants were calculated through absorption measurements. The fluorescence data showed that a static quenching mechanism occurred for both complexes with a binding constant and binding affinity towards DNA (K(b)  approximately  3500 M(-1) and k(q)  approximately  2.1 x 10(11) M(-1) s(-1)). The thermodynamic parameters indicated electrostatic approaching and groove binding were more feasible than intercalation mode between Pt(II) complexes and DNA. CD spectra indicated the increasing intensity of the positive band and the negative band decreasing. Density functional theory calculations confirmed the experimental data and determined the quantum chemical descriptors including total energy, hardness, chemical potential, electrophilicity, electronegativity, etc. According to this, the binding tendency of these compounds with DNA could be predicted. Further, molecular docking studies were also performed. Docking studies revealed that the desolvation, hydrogen, and electrostatic binding were effective for the interaction between complexes and DNA with binding energy (- 10.44 and - 9.57 kcal/mol) for complexes 1 and 2, respectively, which is mainly of partially electrostatic and groove binding type. The cytotoxic activity of Pt complexes was examined against human colon cancer cell line which indicated good activity with IC(50) values of (41.66 and 47.30 muM) for both complexes after 72 h, respectively. Also, they demonstrated more inhibitory effects compared to carboplatin.
abstract_zh: 小分子因其能够显著扰乱核酸天然结构的特性，在癌症治疗中具有潜在应用价值。本研究制备了两种基于Pt(II)、N-异丁基甘氨酸（IBgly）、2,2'-联吡啶和氨的配合物[Pt(NH(3))(2)(IBgly)]NO(3) (1) 和 [Pt(bipy)(IBgly)]NO(3) (2)，并通过光谱方法进行了表征。药代动力学ADME数据、吸收、分布、代谢、排泄及生物利用度雷达图显示，这两种配合物可被引入用于铂基抗癌药物。通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱和圆二色光谱研究了这些化合物的肿瘤抑制机制及与DNA的相互作用。此外，通过吸收测量计算了热力学参数和结合常数。荧光数据表明，两种配合物均发生静态猝灭机制，其对DNA的结合常数和结合亲和力分别为K(b) 约 3500 M(-1) 和 k(q) 约 2.1 x 10(11) M(-1) s(-1)。热力学参数表明，Pt(II)配合物与DNA之间的静电接近和沟槽结合比嵌入模式更为可行。圆二色光谱显示正带强度增加而负带强度降低。密度泛函理论计算证实了实验数据，并确定了量子化学描述符，包括总能量、硬度、化学势、亲电性、电负性等。据此，可预测这些化合物与DNA的结合倾向。此外，还进行了分子对接研究。对接研究表明，去溶剂化、氢键和静电结合对配合物与DNA之间的相互作用有效，配合物1和2的结合能分别为-10.44和-9.57 kcal/mol，主要属于部分静电和沟槽结合类型。铂配合物的细胞毒性活性在人结肠癌细胞系上进行了检测，结果显示在72小时后，两种配合物均表现出良好活性，IC(50)值分别为41.66和47.30 μM。同时，与卡铂相比，它们表现出更强的抑制效果。
